ModMetaData.name: Keep Your Gear
ModMetaData.author: Riketta
ModMetaData.description:
Keep weapon and/or inventory items when a pawn is downed instead of throwing everything on the ground - for colonists and enemies alike, each side with its own options.
Features: - Downed pawns keep weapon and inventory until they recover. - Destroyed hands no longer disarm a pawn. - A kidnapped pawn drops its gear where it was grabbed, so it stays recoverable. - Optional: dead pawns keep their gear on the body.
Stripping, capturing, selling and caravans keep their vanilla behavior.
Successor of "Do Not Drop Weapon" and "Where Is My Weapon?".
Source code & details: https://github.com/Riketta/KeepYourGear
